name: 63042 · Hazelwood, MO
findings: ZIP 63042 (Hazelwood) has 89 nonprofit organizations. 34 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 27 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (35% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 63042 (Hazelwood) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 9 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 9 organizations here; 42% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 63042 (Hazelwood) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 74% of the typical level).
